settings.heading: How does the massager work?
settings.row_content: The device uses deep-kneading massage nodes combined with gentle heat therapy to mimic the hands of a professional therapist. It targets neck, shoulders, and back muscles to relieve tension and improve circulation

settings.heading: Does it need charging or power supply?
settings.row_content: The massager comes with a universal power adapter and can be used by simply plugging it in. Some models also feature rechargeable options for added convenience.

settings.heading: Is the heat function adjustable?
settings.row_content: Yes ✅ The soothing heat can be turned on or off depending on your preference. It provides gentle warmth to enhance relaxation without overheating.

settings.heading: Is it safe to use daily?
settings.row_content: Absolutely. The massager is made with premium, skin-friendly materials and advanced safety features. It is designed for daily and extended use without strain or discomfort.

settings.heading: Is it portable?
settings.row_content: Yes. Compact and lightweight, the massager is easy to carry between your home, office, or while traveling — giving you spa-level relaxation anywhere.

settings.heading: How do I clean and maintain it?
settings.row_content: Simply wipe the surface with a soft, damp cloth. The premium fabric is durable and breathable, ensuring long-lasting comfort with minimal upkeep.

settings.heading: Do you offer Cash on Delivery (COD)?
settings.row_content: Yes ✅ We provide Cash on Delivery across India, along with secure prepaid options. Your purchase is backed by a 30-day replacement warranty, so you can shop with confidence.
